title: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised points of focus 2022), in our own words

controls.title: Integrity and ethics
controls.statement: Leadership sets and shows the values the organization works by, and has a way to see that people follow them.

controls.title: Independent oversight
controls.statement: A governing body that is independent of day-to-day management watches over how internal control is designed and whether it works.

controls.title: Structure and authority
controls.statement: Management has settled who reports to whom, who may decide what, and who answers for which objective, so that security responsibilities have owners.

controls.title: Competent people
controls.statement: The organization hires, trains and keeps people who can do what their roles need, and plans for the skills it will need next.

controls.title: Accountability
controls.statement: People are held to account for their part in internal control, with incentives and consequences that fit the objectives and do not push them to cut corners.

controls.title: Useful information
controls.statement: The organization collects or produces relevant, good-quality information and uses it to run its internal controls.

controls.title: Internal communication
controls.statement: Staff are told what internal control is for and what their own part in it is, through channels that work in both directions, including a way to raise concerns.

controls.title: External communication
controls.statement: The organization tells customers, partners and others outside it what they need to know about its commitments and about matters that bear on internal control, and hears from them.

controls.title: Clear objectives
controls.statement: Objectives are stated clearly enough that the risks to them can be identified and judged.

controls.title: Risk identification
controls.statement: The organization finds the risks to its objectives across the entity and decides how each is to be managed.

controls.title: Fraud risk
controls.statement: When assessing risk the organization considers how fraud, by anyone, could affect its objectives.

controls.title: Change and risk
controls.statement: The organization notices changes that could alter its risks or its internal control, in its environment, its business or its leadership, and assesses them.

controls.title: Evaluating controls
controls.statement: Controls are checked, continuously or at intervals, to learn whether they are present and working.

controls.title: Reporting deficiencies
controls.statement: Weaknesses in control are reported in good time to those who must fix them and to leadership, and followed until they are fixed.

controls.title: Control activities
controls.statement: The organization chooses and builds control activities that bring risks to its objectives down to an acceptable level.

controls.title: Technology controls
controls.statement: The organization chooses and builds general controls over its technology to help meet its objectives.

controls.title: Policies and procedures
controls.statement: Control activities are put into effect through written policies that set expectations and procedures that carry them out.

controls.title: Logical access protection
controls.statement: The systems and information that matter are protected by logical access controls that are designed, put in place and kept up.

controls.title: Access provisioning
controls.statement: Before credentials are issued, users are registered and authorized, and access is removed when it is no longer justified.

controls.title: Least privilege
controls.statement: Access to data and assets is granted, changed and removed according to roles, least privilege and separation of duties.

controls.title: Physical access
controls.statement: Physical access to facilities and protected assets is limited to those authorized, and the limits are enforced.

controls.title: Retiring assets
controls.statement: Assets that hold protected information are made unreadable or physically destroyed before they are discarded or reused.

controls.title: Outside threats
controls.statement: The boundary of the system is protected against threats that come from outside it.

controls.title: Information in motion
controls.statement: The movement, transmission and removal of information is limited to authorized parties, and the information is protected while it moves.

controls.title: Malicious software
controls.statement: The organization prevents or detects software that is unauthorized or harmful, and acts on it.

controls.title: Detecting weaknesses
controls.statement: The organization detects changes to configurations and newly found vulnerabilities that could let a threat succeed.

controls.title: Monitoring for anomalies
controls.statement: Systems and their components are watched for behavior that suggests malicious acts, natural events or mistakes, and what is found is analyzed.

controls.title: Judging events
controls.statement: Security events are assessed to decide whether they have harmed, or could harm, the organization's objectives, which makes them incidents.

controls.title: Incident response
controls.statement: Incidents are handled by a defined program of response: contain, remediate, communicate and learn.

controls.title: Recovery from incidents
controls.statement: The organization restores normal operation after an incident and takes the lessons into its controls.

controls.title: Change management
controls.statement: Changes to infrastructure, data, software and procedures are authorized, designed, developed, tested, approved and put into effect under control.

controls.title: Business disruption
controls.statement: The organization identifies the ways its business could be disrupted and chooses how to reduce the risk, including by insurance.

controls.title: Vendors and partners
controls.statement: The organization assesses and manages the risks that come from its vendors and business partners.

controls.title: Capacity
controls.statement: Processing capacity and use of the system are watched, and capacity is adjusted so that availability commitments can be met.

controls.title: Protection of availability
controls.statement: The organization puts in place the environmental protections, the backups and the recovery infrastructure that availability needs, and looks after them.

controls.title: Testing recovery
controls.statement: The plans for recovering the system are tested, so that it is known whether recovery meets the commitments.

controls.title: Confidential information
controls.statement: Information meant to be confidential is identified and kept protected for as long as the commitments require.

controls.title: Disposing of confidential information
controls.statement: Confidential information is destroyed once it is no longer needed to meet the commitments.

controls.title: Processing specifications
controls.statement: The organization states what the system's processing must produce, and the definitions that data must meet, and keeps them current and understood.

controls.title: Input checks
controls.statement: Policies and procedures check that inputs to the system are complete and accurate as the specifications require.

controls.title: Processing checks
controls.statement: Policies and procedures keep processing complete, valid, accurate and timely, and authorized, as the specifications require.

controls.title: Output checks
controls.statement: Policies and procedures deliver system output only to the intended recipients, and complete and accurate, as the specifications require.

controls.title: Stored data checks
controls.statement: Policies and procedures keep stored data complete and accurate for as long as it is held, as the specifications require.

controls.title: Privacy notice
controls.statement: People whose personal information is handled are given a notice of the organization's practices, at the time it is first collected and when it changes.

controls.title: Choice and consent
controls.statement: The organization tells people what choices they have about their personal information and obtains their consent where it is required.

controls.title: Limited collection
controls.statement: Personal information is collected only as far as the objectives stated in the notice need.

controls.title: Explicit consent for sensitive data
controls.statement: Where the information is sensitive, explicit consent is obtained and recorded before it is collected.

controls.title: Limited use
controls.statement: Personal information is used only for the purposes the notice states and the person consented to.

controls.title: Retention
controls.statement: Personal information is kept only as long as the stated purposes and the law need.

controls.title: Disposal of personal information
controls.statement: Personal information that is no longer needed is securely disposed of.

controls.title: Access by the person
controls.statement: People can see the personal information the organization holds about them, subject to stated exceptions.

controls.title: Correction
controls.statement: People can ask for their personal information to be corrected, and the organization acts on valid requests and tells those concerned.

controls.title: Disclosure with consent
controls.statement: Personal information goes to third parties only for the purposes stated and with the person's consent.

controls.title: Record of authorized disclosures
controls.statement: The organization keeps a record of the disclosures of personal information it has authorized.

controls.title: Record of unauthorized disclosures
controls.statement: The organization keeps a record of unauthorized disclosures and of breaches of personal information.

controls.title: Third parties' obligations
controls.statement: Agreements require third parties that handle personal information to meet the organization's privacy commitments, and their compliance is checked.

controls.title: Third parties report incidents
controls.statement: Third parties are bound to tell the organization of breaches and incidents involving personal information so that it can respond.

controls.title: Notifying of breaches
controls.statement: The organization tells those affected, and others as required, of breaches of personal information.

controls.title: Accounting of disclosures
controls.statement: On request the organization can tell a person what personal information it holds about them and to whom it has disclosed it.

controls.title: Quality of personal information
controls.statement: Personal information is kept accurate, complete and relevant for the purposes it is used for.

controls.title: Privacy monitoring and enforcement
controls.statement: The organization handles privacy inquiries, complaints and disputes, and checks that it complies with its privacy commitments.
